title: Measurement reports
noSensor: Choose a sensor to view its report, including manually added sensors.
rangeHelp: Defaults to the last 24 hours. Choose up to 31 days, ending no later than now. Enter local times; groups use UTC.
meanHelp: Minimum/maximum retain exact recorded precision. Means are rounded to 9 decimal places, half away from zero.
noInterval: No expected reporting interval configured; no inferred gap count.
alertHelp: Counts cover this sensor’s history for the selected period, including the start and end times.
empty: No recorded readings in this period. No values are estimated.
chartHelp: The line shows the average and the band shows the minimum and maximum. Missing data leaves a gap. Use the table for exact values.
exportHelp: CSV in UTF-8 with UTC dates and exact values, up to {count} readings. Oversized exports are rejected; text that could become a spreadsheet formula is escaped.
exportNarrow: Narrow the period to export its raw readings.

errors.tooManyReadings: This period exceeds 100,000 readings. Choose a shorter period.
errors.exportTooLarge: Too much data to export. Choose a shorter period (up to 10,000 readings).
errors.unitMismatch: This sensor has readings with different units. A report or export cannot combine them.
errors.unavailable: The report could not be prepared. Please try again.

validation.timeInvalid: Enter a valid timezone-qualified date and time.
validation.inputInvalid: Check the reporting period and grouping.
validation.rangeInvalid: Choose an ordered period of at most 31 days, ending no later than the data cutoff. The cutoff cannot be in the future.
